reason: Approve within the commerce advertising scope: the encoded samples identify the actual digital product, distinguish the PDF from app recipes and tools, display the owner-authorized 15.99 SAR, and end with a stable product CTA and store address. Catalog quantity and training options match the inspected local data. The delivered MP4/player evidence supports the requested review and download handoff. This vote does not certify subjective narration quality or a functioning purchase/fulfillment journey.

evidence.inspection: Personally inspected with view_image. At 8.650s the recognizable faceless character presents the book; at 12.575s the product feature list distinguishes the app; at 15.700s the 4/5-day programs appear; at 18.550s the calculator is labeled an illustrative estimate; at 22.775s 500 recipes are explicitly in the app; at 27.650s and 29.700s 15.99 SAR and mdaar21.zid.store remain visible.

Personally inspected the contact sheet with view_image. Sampled transitions show the product entering around 6.5–7.08s and the closing offer appearing around 25.68–26.08s. These are sampled images, not continuous playback observation.

Price is explicitly owner-supplied for this ad. The map limits 500 recipes to the app and explanation links to the PDF, with no guaranteed outcomes, artificial urgency, store edits, purchases or fulfillment claims.

Read local JSON: 500 recipe entries with 500 distinct IDs; training programs have trainingDays 4 and 5. The source also states qualified professional review is pending, so this is catalog corroboration, not clinical endorsement.
Read actual HTML: native video controls, direct MP4/MP3/SRT download links and a separate product-store link. Displayed price is 15.99 SAR. No purchase action was performed.

Inspected records report 1080x1920, 60/1 fps, 1788 frames, 29.8s, zero decode warnings and a settled 3.45s CTA hold. Source browser reports product visible by 7.2s. Did not independently rerun encoding/playback.

Inspected recorded evidence for 320/390/1440px viewports, successful native decoding/seeking/download checks, no overflow/runtime errors, live HTTP 200 matching hashes and HTTP 206 range support. These are recorded tests, not my own live browser session.
Confirmed exact supplied version/digest and independently hashed delivered MP4, player HTML and creative SRT; all three match their frozen manifest entries.

strengths: Accurate distinction between PDF and app benefits reduces ambiguity about what the buyer receives.
Owner-authorized price and held CTA are legible in the encoded closing samples.
Actual app screenshots and estimated-example labels substantiate the advertised tools without claiming medical precision.
limitations: No human listening capability: reports/audio-edit.json and reports/voice-separation.json show no pitch/time change and no added music track, but learned source separation may leave artifacts or music. Naturalness, intelligibility and perfect music removal remain unverified by this reviewer; approval is limited to commerce/catalog and delivery presentation.
No continuous video watching, perceptual motion assessment, audience study or conversion testing was performed.

No live store availability, actual checkout price, taxes, payment, entitlement, delivery, refunds or fulfillment was tested or claimed. The owner-supplied ad price is not evidence of store configuration.
PDF link availability and third-party exercise playback were not independently tested.
non_applicable_criteria: Order lifecycle, inventory changes, payment reconciliation, fulfillment execution and post-purchase support are outside this authorized ad remake.
Medical fitness, formal legal compliance, sales performance and verification of all fifty independent contexts are not certified by this individual commerce review.
